props.name: accessEndsAt
props.description: When paid access ends if the cancellation goes through.

props.name: losses
props.description: What stops working — named features and data, not “premium features”.

props.name: reasons
props.description: Reasons offered on the first step, each optionally paired with an offer.

props.name: offers
props.description: Copy for each offer the product can make. An offer without copy is never shown.

props.name: onAcceptOffer
props.description: Called when an offer is taken instead of cancelling.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called on the final confirmation. A rejected promise shows its message.

props.name: onKeep
props.description: Leave the flow without changing anything.
